policy: Provisional 2027 prices with EUR as the sole reference: normal monthly EUR list prices for 1–6 applications per user are €30, €50, €72, €91, €107 and €135. Early adopters receive exactly 20% off these EUR prices during their first year, when starting between 1 January and 31 March 2027. DKK and USD are display-only conversions using the same published reference rates; do not treat converted figures as independent subscription prices. Organisation discounts are evaluated in EUR, and do not stack with the early adopter discount. All amounts exclude VAT. Checkout and billing are not live.

referenceConversion.note: EUR is the only base price and intended billing currency. DKK and USD values are display equivalents converted from EUR using these indicative reference rates and rounded to two decimals. All discounts and totals must be computed in EUR before converting once for display. Rates are fixed until the published reference is updated; no live-FX guarantee.

derivedDisplayCurrencyNote: Do not independently edit converted DKK or USD prices: derive all display amounts from the EUR reference pricing.
